_comment: Hand-captured fixture for tests/model-sync-host-test.mjs. Captured once from the live
provider and collector on 2026-11-02 and then edited by hand, deliberately: a test that
reads the live world tests the provider rather than the code. On 2026-11-02 the provider
dropped five models in the morning and re-enabled them in the afternoon, reddening this
suite twice inside prepublishOnly for reasons that were not defects.
Nothing here is 'the current truth'. The live enabled count was 9, then 14, and it will
oscillate again. These ids exist to express transitions the code must handle, and the
fixture is free to hold states the live provider does not offer today.
Every id below is named in _roles so a reader can see what each one is for. An id with no
role is decoration and proves nothing.

_roles.glm-5.3: served, installed, and stays served: the stable case, and the only model whose output cap differs from the others, so a capacity read is distinguishable from a default
_roles.claude-opus-5-5: served and installed with a full description and a hand-written compat: proves both survive regeneration rather than being rebuilt from the catalogue
_roles.fable-ultra-promax: installed but NOT served: the plan must retire it, and its compat must not be carried onto anything else
_roles.deepseek-v4.1-flash: installed but NOT served: a second retirement, so the assertion is not about one lucky id
_roles.kimi-k3: served and in the catalogue but NOT installed: the plan must add it — the re-addition direction, which is what a retirement-only fixture would have missed
_roles.qwen3.8-max: served, in the catalogue under its canonical id AND under a zonal twin: the badge bug, where two catalogues disagreed about an id and the model the user picks lost its mark
_roles.abyss/qwen3.8-max: the zonal twin of qwen3.8-max: same name, same icon, must not shadow the canonical id
_roles.no-icon-model: served and in the catalogue with an empty icon name: an icon absence is an ordinary answer and must not drop the record
_roles.no-capacity-model: served and in the catalogue with no contextK and no maxOutputTokens: the plan must say the window is unpublished rather than inventing one
_roles.fixture-only-sentinel: present in the catalogue but never served and never installed. Its only job is provenance: if it reaches the mirror, the mirror came from this file and not from the network
